Newly DM-adjudicated public documentary details, consistent with fixed roles: Noldren Tavosk is listed as petition representative for several freight households including the joint freight account. One current public petition proposes allowing approved carriers to use simplified declaration procedures at private berths, ostensibly reducing delays; petition remains under consideration, no exemption enacted. House Veldrake is an established landed family represented commercially by Lady Halvessa Veldrake, its senior household patron, and purchasing agent Jorveth Sallow. Both given names and Sallow checked via repo search zero prior matches before introduction; Veldrake already established. Public commercial contact entry bears an agent stamp matching the visual sketch V made in broker office, supporting identification of purchasing agent; no formal authentication or proof of Lady Halvessa's personal authorization. Household maintains an Orsaven townhouse in Old Crown ward, commercial correspondence addressed to Sallow through household office. These are first-play fixed ordinary public record details, not recovered preexisting historical facts, no specific estate valuation, political faction allegiance, genealogy, investment, secret supper, petition approval or criminal verdict invented. No suspect contacted, no alert or new actor reaction asserted. Veldrake purchases and Tavosk payment remain allegations supported by actual earlier evidence, not proof of all household members' complicity or connection to Quenwood murders. Mara identifies the concrete correspondence route and recommends sharing findings with Desen before any direct approach; Cirren wants independent confirmation of Sallow's actual authority and who authorized purchases. No new compulsory errand, no expenditure, roll, rest or automatic decision. Watch retains original lot27 invoice36gp and sealed14gp Tavosk acknowledgement, faithful copy of V's notes; Cirren holds signed evidence receipt, V holds original handwritten notes.
